grid.title: 1 — Electricity grid
grid.description: Map available grid measurements, or leave empty. Signed grid power keeps its sign; export is shown as a positive magnitude. These readings are not added together. No commands will be sent.

solar.title: 2 — Solar production
solar.description: Choose a total production measurement in W or kW, or leave empty if you have no solar installation.

home.title: 3 — Home consumption
home.description: Choose measured total home consumption in W or kW. This first increment does not calculate a balance or add submeters. Continue to configure batteries or skip storage.

review.title: 5 — Review measurements

confirm.title: Save in observation mode
confirm.description:
{summary}

Submit to save in observation mode, without commands. Settings reload without a full HA restart. An initial dashboard can be exported afterwards using ehome_ems.generate_dashboard. Balances and animated flows are still to be developed. To correct an error, select return to review.

batteries.title: 4 — Storage
batteries.description:
Add your batteries, or continue without storage. Each battery has separate readings. Backup is the default role.

{summary}

add_battery.title: Add a battery
add_battery.description: Map at least one reading. Charge and discharge must be distinct positive sensors. SOC is not an energy counter. Remaining energy is measured, never estimated from SOC. DC storage is monitored but excluded from the future simple AC balance.

battery_details.title: Edit battery measurements
battery_details.description: Map at least one reading. Charge and discharge must be distinct positive sensors. SOC is not an energy counter. Remaining energy is measured, never estimated from SOC. DC storage is monitored but excluded from the future simple AC balance.

remove_battery.title: Remove battery from monitoring
remove_battery.description: Removal is applied at final confirmation. It does not command the device or remove its original integration.

error.select_source: Select at least one sensor before saving.
error.duplicate_source: This sensor is already mapped to another reading.
error.recursive_source: Select an original source, not an eHome EMS sensor.
error.missing_source: This sensor no longer exists. Choose another source.
error.unsupported_unit: Invalid unit: W/kW for power, % for SOC, Wh/kWh for remaining energy.
error.sources_changed: A source is missing, duplicated or has an invalid unit. Return to review to correct the mappings.
error.invalid_battery: Check name, role, coupling and capacity (a finite positive number).

abort.already_configured: eHome EMS is already configured. Use Configure to edit its settings.
